plan.summary: Add a REVERSE movement order that moves a vehicle one grid cell opposite its current orientation without changing that orientation, while preserving existing board-boundary and simultaneous-collision rules.
steps: Add REVERSE to the supported MovementOrder values.
Add position logic for moving one cell opposite a supplied orientation.

Handle REVERSE when MovementEngine calculates vehicle intentions, retaining the vehicle's current orientation and allowing the existing validation and collision-resolution phases to process the movement.
Document reverse vectors, orientation preservation, boundary behavior, and applicability of the existing simultaneous collision rules, and remove reverse movement from the out-of-scope list.
tests: Extend MovementEngineTest to verify reverse movement for NORTH, EAST, SOUTH, and WEST orientations and confirm orientation remains unchanged.
Verify reverse movement beyond each board edge is blocked.

Verify reverse orders participate in existing collision behavior, including movement into a stationary vehicle, multiple vehicles targeting one cell, position swaps, and movement into a successfully vacated cell.
Run the backend unit test suite with ./mvnw test.
